name: rich-editor-monorepo
description: Production-ready Vue 3 rich text editor with MathML formulas (math + chemistry), media and i18n

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rich-editor/core && npm run build -w @rich-editor/vue && node scripts/copy-legacy-css.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rich-editor/core && npm run typecheck -w @rich-editor/vue && npm run typecheck -w @rich-editor/demo
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
